title: Jerome D'Souza
summary: Supports the democratic creed while warning against state regimentation and cultural absorption of minorities.

title: H. J. Khandekar
summary: Supports the Resolution while demanding meaningful Scheduled Caste representation and concrete safeguards for oppressed communities.

title: H. C. Mookherjee
summary: Supports the Resolution as a minority representative and stresses civic, political and religious rights.

title: S. H. Prater
summary: Moves from earlier support for postponement to immediate adoption, linking provincial autonomy, Union and minority protection to constitutional compromise.

title: M. R. Jayakar
summary: Withdraws his postponement amendment after the Assembly had delayed debate until January, triggering a short procedural dispute over whether he could add new suggestions.

title: C. M. Poonacha
summary: Defends popular sovereignty in the princely States and frames constitution-making as an obligation to future generations.

title: Vishwambhar Dayal Tripathi
summary: Presses for socialist guarantees and an explicit declaration of Constituent Assembly sovereignty derived from the people.
